description: Work with Rapid7 InsightVM vulnerability management: search assets and vulnerabilities, see what changed on an asset, start, check and stop scans, and start workflows when a scan finishes, a new asset or vulnerability is found, or a vulnerability is fixed.

rapid7_insightvm_new_asset_trigger.description: Runs when an asset (a server, workstation or device) appears in InsightVM for the first time, with its address, operating system, risk score and vulnerability counts. Assets already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.critical_vulnerabilities: How many critical vulnerabilities it has.
output.moderate_vulnerabilities: How many moderate vulnerabilities it has.
output.severe_vulnerabilities: How many severe vulnerabilities it has.
output.sites: The names of the sites it belongs to.
output.total_vulnerabilities: How many vulnerabilities it has in all.
output.type: guest, hypervisor, physical, mobile or unknown.

parameters.description: Only assets matching these InsightVM asset criteria, such as os_family = 'Windows'. Leave blank for every asset.
parameters.name: asset_filter

rapid7_insightvm_new_vulnerability_trigg.description: Runs once for each vulnerability a scan or agent newly finds on an asset, critical ones by default, with the asset, the vulnerability and the solution that fixes it. Findings already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.first_found: When InsightVM first found it on the asset.
output.port: The vulnerable port, for a service vulnerability.
output.proof: What InsightVM saw that shows the vulnerability.
output.protocol: The vulnerable protocol, such as TCP.
output.remediation_date: When it was fixed, for a remediated vulnerability.
output.solution_id: The id of the solution that fixes it.
output.status: How it was found, such as VULNERABLE_VERS or VULNERABLE_EXPL.
output.vulnerability_id: The vulnerability's InsightVM id, such as 7-zip-cve-2008-6536.

parameters.description: Only vulnerabilities this severe or worse: critical, severe or moderate. Leave blank for critical only.
parameters.name: lowest_severity

parameters.description: Only assets matching these InsightVM asset criteria, such as os_family = 'Windows'. Leave blank for every asset.
parameters.name: asset_filter

rapid7_insightvm_scan_finished_trigger.description: Runs when an InsightVM scan completes, fails or is stopped, with its status and start and end times. Scans that finished before the workflow was turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.engine_id: The id of the engine that ran it.
output.name: The scan's name.
output.status: InsightVM's status for the scan, such as Success or Stopped.

parameters.description: Only scans that ended this way: completed, failed or stopped. Leave blank for all three.
parameters.name: outcome

rapid7_insightvm_vulnerability_remediate.description: Runs once for each vulnerability InsightVM finds fixed on an asset, with the asset, the vulnerability and when it was fixed. Fixes made before the workflow was turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.first_found: When InsightVM first found it on the asset.
output.port: The vulnerable port, for a service vulnerability.
output.proof: What InsightVM saw that shows the vulnerability.
output.protocol: The vulnerable protocol, such as TCP.
output.remediation_date: When it was fixed, for a remediated vulnerability.
output.solution_id: The id of the solution that fixes it.
output.status: How it was found, such as VULNERABLE_VERS or VULNERABLE_EXPL.
output.vulnerability_id: The vulnerability's InsightVM id, such as 7-zip-cve-2008-6536.

parameters.description: Only vulnerabilities this severe or worse: critical, severe or moderate. Leave blank for every severity.
parameters.name: lowest_severity

parameters.description: Only assets matching these InsightVM asset criteria, such as os_family = 'Windows'. Leave blank for every asset.
parameters.name: asset_filter
